native.tcp_edition: Actual base edition or separately qualified variant.
native.tcp_proposal_mode: Explicit source baseline proposal versus actual negotiated configuration.
native.tcp_ip_version: Actual bound IP version; TCP not implicitly Ethernet.
native.tcp_phase: Actual transmitted vs received segment; unknown receiver reserved bits ignored.
native.tcp_state: Actual endpoint state, ACK does not prove application consumption.
native.tcp_congestion: Actual selected algorithm; no Reno rule applied to CUBIC/registered algorithms.
native.tcp_iw_profile: Actual initial-window policy independent of congestion avoidance algorithm.
native.tcp_rto_profile: Actual timer policy; standard SHOULD floor vs separately evidenced deviation.
native.tcp_rto_phase: Actual initial, first RTT, updatedRTT or timeout state.
native.tcp_recovery_phase: Actual no loss, slow start, Renoavoidance, timeout or fast recovery.
native.tcp_src_port: Actual16-bit source port; wire value0 not a guessed service.
native.tcp_dst_port: Actual16-bit destination port, endpoint binding must be explicit.
native.tcp_acknowledgment: Actual32bit next expected octet, meaningful only ACKset.
native.tcp_syn_units: Actual SYN consumes1 sequenceunit when set.
native.tcp_fin_units: Actual FIN consumes1 sequenceunit when set.
native.tcp_option_kind: Actual IANAoption kind; mandatory0/1/2 and selected3/8 checked.
native.tcp_option_length: Actual complete optionlength includes kind+length; EOL/NOP have no lengthfield.
native.tcp_reserved_bits: Actual4bit reservedfield, SENDzero unless separately registeredextension; receiverignore.
native.tcp_urgent_pointer: Actual16bit offset to octet afterurgentdata, not out-of-band deliveryproof.
native.tcp_data_bytes: Actualsegmentdata, no relationship to socketwrite boundaries.
native.tcp_mss_received: Actual16bit peerMSS offer or sourcefallback when absent.
native.tcp_idle_s: Actualidle time pertinent to PAWS staleclock.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application stream bytes with separate segment MSS, IP reassembly limits and application framing. No65535byte application cap or clock inferred from TCP.

revisions: RFC9293 August2022 sections2/3.1-3.8; base TCP no physical clock/application-message boundary.
RFC7323 September2014 sections2-5; WS/TS negotiated, SYN window unscaled, PAWS clock distinct UTC.
RFC6298 June2011 sections2-5: first/subsequentRTT, Karn, backoff; SHOULD defaults not hardware facts.
RFC5681 September2009 sections2-4: Reno congestion/receive windows separate and loss recovery.
RFC9438 August2023 sections3/4/5.1; originalPDF figures1/2 visually reviewed onprinted9. Own CUBIC windows use SMSS-sized segments not byte counters.
RFC6928 April2013 Experimental sections1/2: optional IW10 upperbound, not universal default and no1500byteMTU assumption.
scope: Every exported TCP field individually reviewed, own industryneutral explicit IP path. Foreign CAN/Ethernet timing/MTU/bitrate fields removed; parameter evidence EXPLICIT_LAYER and native scope avoids silently qualifying actual lower layers.

Typed segment header/options/pseudoheader/checksum and modulo sequence relations; absent MSS fallback depends IPv4/IPv6, effective sendbudget accounts actual peer and IP options. WS/TS require negotiation; SYN windows unscaled, received shifts clamp14, timestamps monotonic notUTC.

Actual RTT samples, oldSRTT-before-RTTVAR update, Karn timestamp condition, sourcebaseline1second floor, optional actual cap, initial and timeout rules. Nagle/keepalive configurable; one lost probe not connection death. No guessed LAN granularity or two-minute actual path bound.
Reno and optional IW10 separate; flight vs cwnd vs rwnd. CUBIC own segment units, signed epoch-root relation and cubic/nextRTT target clamping; no Reno growth rule applied to CUBIC.

Sourceconditional header/RTO/weights/MSS/keepalive/Nagle/CUBIC proposals do not confirm actual sockets, addresses, negotiated windows, sample clocks or capacity. Complete source+transport+consumer functional timing and consuming freshness remain independently required.
